title: 793: The Raid That Started the Viking Age
style: Full-bleed close-up of a hand-embroidered medieval tapestry: the stitched scene fills the ENTIRE frame edge to edge, cropped inside the fabric so no cloth edges, no linen margins, no blank background, no frame and no white space are visible. NO decorative border, no ornamental band, no animal frieze along any edge: only the scene itself. Dense visible thread stitches and woven linen texture everywhere, muted natural palette of cream, slate blue, moss green, ochre and rust red, swirling stitched clouds, flat storybook perspective, no text, no letters
motion: Keep the hand-embroidered tapestry look and thread texture exactly. Gentle, slow animation only:

scenes.narration: June, seven ninety-three. On a tiny island off England's northeast coast, the monks begin another quiet day of prayer.
scenes.image: A small stone monastery with a bell tower on a green island at dawn, pale sunrise, calm grey-blue sea, monks in brown robes walking on a path
scenes.motion: the sunrise glow slowly brightens, the sea ripples softly, clouds drift, slow camera push-in

scenes.narration: This is Lindisfarne. Holy Island. Twice a day, the tide rises and cuts it off from the mainland.
scenes.image: Wide view of a tidal island with a long sandy causeway to the mainland, sea water flowing over the sand, small monastery on the island, coastline and dunes
scenes.motion: tide water slowly flows across the sandy causeway, waves roll gently, clouds drift, slow pan right

scenes.narration: For a hundred and fifty years, it has been one of the brightest centres of learning in all of Europe.
scenes.image: Stone monastery on a grassy cliff top above the sea, monks gathered in the cloister garden, warm golden light, birds in the sky
scenes.motion: birds glide across the sky, grass sways in the wind, monks walk slowly, gentle camera drift

scenes.narration: Here, monks spent years painting the Lindisfarne Gospels, one of the most beautiful books ever made.
scenes.image: Interior of a medieval scriptorium with stone arches, a monk at a wooden writing desk illuminating a large book with gold and colourful patterns, shelves of books, candle light
scenes.motion: the candle flame flickers, the monk's hand moves slowly painting the page, dust drifts in the light, slow push-in

scenes.narration: Its treasures were famous. Gold, silver, jewelled books. And the island had no walls, no soldiers, and no warning.
scenes.image: Church altar with gold chalices, silver crosses and a jewelled book cover glittering, candles, stone arches, open doorway showing the sea
scenes.motion: candle flames flicker, gold treasures glint softly, light shifts slowly, slow camera push-in

scenes.narration: That year, a chronicler wrote of terrible omens. Whirlwinds, lightning, and fiery dragons flying through the sky.
scenes.image: Stormy sky above the island monastery with stitched lightning bolts, swirling whirlwinds and two fiery red dragons flying in the clouds, frightened monks looking up
scenes.motion: the dragons glide through swirling clouds, lightning flashes, clouds churn slowly, camera tilts up

scenes.narration: Then, across the North Sea, long ships appeared. Low and fast, with striped sails and carved dragon heads.
scenes.image: Three Viking longships with red and white striped square sails and carved dragon-head prows sailing across rough grey-blue sea, round shields along the sides
scenes.motion: the longships sail forward over rolling waves, sails billow in the wind, oars dip, slow pan following the ships

scenes.narration: They came from Scandinavia. Men who knew the sea better than anyone alive, and who knew exactly what they wanted.
scenes.image: Close view of Viking warriors with round helmets and shields rowing a longship, determined faces, dragon-head prow, sea spray
scenes.motion: the warriors row in rhythm, sea spray rises, the sail ripples, gentle rocking motion

scenes.narration: The ships ran straight onto the beach. There was no harbour to defend, and no time to run.
scenes.image: Viking longships landing on a sandy beach below the cliff-top monastery, warriors jumping into the shallow surf, monks on the cliff in the distance
scenes.motion: the longships glide onto the sand, surf washes up the beach, warriors wade ashore, slow push-in

scenes.narration: The raiders tore through the church. Altars were stripped, treasures carried away, and the monks who resisted were cut down.
scenes.image: Viking raiders carrying gold chalices, crosses and treasure chests out of the stone church doorway, monks fleeing, overturned candles, dramatic but not gory
scenes.motion: raiders walk out carrying treasure, monks run, candle smoke drifts, slow camera drift

scenes.narration: Some were drowned in the sea. Others were dragged aboard the ships, to be sold as slaves.
scenes.image: Monks in brown robes being led onto Viking longships at the shoreline by warriors, grey sea, heavy clouds, sombre mood
scenes.motion: waves wash against the ships, figures move slowly toward the boats, clouds darken, slow pan

scenes.narration: And then, as fast as they had come, the ships were gone, leaving smoke rising over the holy island.
scenes.image: Longships sailing away on the horizon while dark smoke rises from the monastery on the cliff, embers, wide quiet sea
scenes.motion: smoke curls upward slowly, the ships shrink toward the horizon, waves roll, slow pull-back

scenes.narration: Across Europe, the news landed like a thunderclap. The scholar Alcuin wrote that such terror had never before been seen in Britain.
scenes.image: A medieval scholar in robes writing a letter with a quill at a desk in a stone hall, candle light, a window showing a distant stormy sea
scenes.motion: the quill moves across the parchment, the candle flickers, rain streaks the window, slow push-in

scenes.narration: But Lindisfarne was only the beginning. For almost three hundred years, Vikings would raid, trade, and settle across Europe.
scenes.image: A busy Viking harbour town with thatched longhouses, wooden palisade, market stalls, longships with striped sails moored at a wooden pier, smoke from chimneys
scenes.motion: chimney smoke drifts, sails ripple, water laps against the pier, people move about the market, slow pan

scenes.narration: Historians would give it a name. The Viking Age. And it began on one quiet morning, on one small island.
scenes.image: The island monastery at sunset with a single longship silhouette on the horizon, calm sea, warm orange and rust sky with swirling stitched clouds
scenes.motion: the sun slowly sinks, the sea shimmers, the distant ship drifts, very slow pull-back
